runs.name: BD-rate binary unit tests
runs.command: nice -n 15 deltic timeout 900 env TMPDIR=/private/var/folders/bl/xncqcmfj4cj3b8z7j0sy78rr0000gn/T/deltic-scratch/rvp9-zero-work-tests-fcf1e314 CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/private/var/folders/bl/xncqcmfj4cj3b8z7j0sy78rr0000gn/T/deltic-scratch/rvp9-zero-work-tests-fcf1e314/target CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=1 CARGO_NET_OFFLINE=true cargo test -p rvp9-bench --bin bdrate --locked --offline -- --test-threads=1 </dev/null
coverage: Rejects failed PSNR, insufficient points and repeated-PSNR overlapping fits.
Exercises external encoder and decoder timeouts.
Rejects missing BD-rate output and checks deterministic, collision-free temporary artifacts.

limits: These focused unit suites are exact-candidate regression evidence, not codec quality or release performance measurements.
Passing full-rank finite-curve unit cases does not establish BD-rate numerical accuracy; FLU-00042 remains open and blocks quality acceptance until owner repair and validation.
These soak unit tests do not replace a production-mode soak, macOS RSS observation, or the approved long-duration deferrals.
